A '''nurse''' was on duty in the infirmary ward of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] murder investigation into the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Tanith Sorn]]. This [[Nurse/Legends|nurse]] tended to the critically wounded [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ein Truminn]].
